causal_interpretation: The hard root-iteration and constitutive-evaluation bounds were respected, so the failure is not an unbounded-cost failure.
B01 and O14 demonstrate that the bounded local-solve formulation is numerically viable for less pathological near-saturation constitutive shapes.
B12 and O13 fail both bracket completeness and frozen accuracy metrics under the single global t^8 GL128 quadrature.
Their worst errors occur on long WET_DRY paths beginning at positive saturated head and extending thousands of centimeters into the dry range.

The evidence is consistent with inadequate fixed resolution of constitutive variation over many orders of magnitude in absolute negative head, not with the previously rejected table interpolation problem.
Because GL128, t^8 and 64 bisection steps were frozen, they are not retuned within E2C.
